title: Minimal energy expression
description: Essential: The final answer for E_min must be correctly expressed as h^2/(8mL^2).

title: General energy formula
description: Essential: The final expression for E_n must be h^2 n^2 / (8mL^2) with n as a positive integer.

title: Photon wavelength calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for λ_21 must be correctly derived from ΔE = E2 - E1 and expressed as 8mcL^2/(3h).

title: De Broglie wavelength relation
description: Important: The typical de Broglie wavelength λ_dB must be correctly related to momentum via λ = h/p.

title: Critical temperature derivation
description: Important: The critical temperature T_c must be derived by setting λ_dB ≈ ℓ, resulting in h^2 n^(2/3) / (3 m k_B).

title: Interparticle distance
description: Important: The typical distance ℓ must be correctly expressed as n^(-1/3) from the particle density n.

title: Energy difference for photon
description: Important: The photon energy must equal the energy difference ΔE = E2 - E1 for the transition.

title: Incorrect momentum constant
description: Pitfall: Using p = sqrt(2mk_BT) instead of the correct typical p = sqrt(3mk_BT) for the gas calculation.

title: Missing or wrong quantum number
description: Pitfall: Stating E_min = 0 or using an incorrect quantum number n (e.g., n=0) for the particle in a box.

title: Unit or constant confusion
description: Pitfall: Confusing Planck's constant h with ħ (h-bar) in the energy or wavelength formulas.
